name: speedtest-tracker
summary: [Speedtest-tracker](https://github.com/alexjustesen/speedtest-tracker) is a self-hosted internet performance tracking application that runs speedtest checks against Ookla's Speedtest service.

volumes.description: Contains speedtest-tracker config and database, if using sqlite.

env.name: APP_KEY
env.description: App key used for encrypting stored data. You can generate a key as per [https://speedtest-tracker.dev](https://docs.speedtest-tracker.dev/getting-started/installation/using-docker-compose#install-with-docker-compose)

env.name: APP_URL
env.description: The IP:port or URL your application will be accessed on (ie. `http://192.168.1.1:6875` or `https://bookstack.mydomain.com`

env.name: DB_CONNECTION
env.description: Set the database type to use. `sqlite`, `pgsql`, or `mysql`

env.name: SPEEDTEST_SCHEDULE
env.description: Set the test schedule in cron format. e.g. `0 */6 * * *`

env.name: SPEEDTEST_SERVERS
env.description: A comma-separated list of server IDs to test against. Run `docker run -it --rm --entrypoint /bin/bash lscr.io/linuxserver/speedtest-tracker:latest list-servers` to get a list of nearby servers.

docs.setup:
Access the web UI at `<your-ip>:80`, the default credentials are admin@example.com / password

For more information check out the [project documentation](https://docs.speedtest-tracker.dev/).

changelog.text: Update nginx configs for v1.7.2. Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid errors.
Cache Filament components and added APP_KEY as a required param.
Existing users should update their nginx confs to avoid http2 deprecation warnings.
Rebase to Alpine 3.19, upgrade to php 8.3.
